description: This file defines the ManageNotebooksFragment class, which is a UI component for managing notebooks within an Android application. It handles displaying a list of notebooks, sorting options, user interactions such as creating, renaming, deleting notebooks, and navigation to specific notebook details.

classes.name: ManageNotebooksFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that provides UI for managing notebooks, including listing, sorting, creating, renaming, and deleting notebooks.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes RecyclerView, sets up UI event handlers, and prepares the fragment upon view creation.

methods.name: setupRecyclerView
methods.description: Configures the RecyclerView with its adapter, layout manager, and user interaction handlers.

methods.name: enlistNotebooks
methods.description: Collects notebook data from the ViewModel, applies sorting based on user preferences, and updates the UI list.

methods.name: selectSortMethodItem
methods.description: Updates the menu to reflect the current sorting method.
